title.en: El Perro del Gorro Atornillado al Cráneo

altTitles.en: The Guy with a Cap Screwed Onto His Skull
The Dog With A Cap Screwed Onto His Skull
The Dog with the Hat Screwed to the Skull

description.en:
*Winner of the MangaPlus Creators July 2023 Bronze Award*

After someone dear is taken away from him, all that's left is the desire for vengeance. It's under the shadow of his friend's parting words, "don't trust anyone," that "the guy" lives—a mysterious warrior known by this moniker for never uttering his true name. Now, he will be face to face with his target, and he will have to make a decision!
description.es-la: Luego de que le arrebaten a alguien importante lo único que le queda es el deseo de venganza, y las últimas palabras de su amigo “nunca confíes en nadie”, bajo esta frase vive “el perro”, un guerrero misterioso al que llaman así por nunca decir su nombre, ahora estará frente a frente a su objetivo ¡y tendrá que tomar una decisión!
